about.metaDesc: The story of Zayn Sajju: a graphic designer turned video editor who makes UGC ads, AI UGC ads and product video ads that convert.
about.title: Hi, I'm Zayn Sajju
paras: I started in 2021 with basic graphic design, learning the fundamentals of layout, color and typography. Over time I moved into Amazon listing images, then into video editing.
Today my main focus is creating UGC ads, AI UGC ads and professional product video ads for brands and online sellers.
What makes me different is that I combine graphic design with video editing. Every ad I make looks polished and is built to convert, not just to look good.
about.mission: To help brands and sellers turn their products into scroll-stopping visuals and ads that earn attention, build trust and drive more sales.
